message.content:
These are plastic parts of aviation headsets. Headsets fall under 8518.30 (headphones and earphones, whether or not combined with a microphone). Parts of those goods go to 8518.90. The plastic knobs and buttons are not general plastic articles of Chapter 39. Under Section XVI Note 2(b), parts that are suitable for use solely or principally with a particular machine are classified with that machine, and Note 1(f) excludes only Chapter 39 parts that are general-purpose parts, which these are not.

The matching subheading is 8518.90, "Parts" of headphones, earphones, microphones and the like. The statistical suffix for 8518.90 is 8518.90.80 ("Other"), and the 10-digit number is 8518.90.8000. I recall the other 8518.90 lines as 8518.90.20 for printed circuit assemblies and 8518.90.40 for other parts of loudspeakers, but I am less sure of these.

I'm choosing 8518.90.8000 as the best fit.

{"hts_code": "8518.90.8000", "reason": "Plastic knob, cover and button are identifiable parts solely or principally used with headsets (headphones/earphones combined with microphone of heading 8518.30), so they classify as parts in 8518.90."}
